missed_day: You were absent yesterday. Don't explain. Sit.
A lapse. Note it, then drop it. Regret is wasted focus.
The mind wanders. Bring it back. Same with the day.
Yesterday is not my concern. Today is.
You broke the pattern. Start a new one. Now.
I waited. You did not come. I'm still waiting.
Missing once is nothing. Getting comfortable with it is everything.
You lost a day. Don't lose another looking for it.
Distraction won yesterday. It does not win twice.
Discipline is a promise to yourself. You broke one. Keep the next.
No training. No progress. Simple arithmetic.
I don't need you to feel bad. I need you to sit down and focus.
Hmph. Yesterday you let the noise win.
comeback: Hmph. So you can be taught.
Coming back is harder than starting. I noticed.
No ceremony. You're here. That is enough.
The lapse is over. Don't carry it into the session.
You sat down without being told. Progress.
A mind that returns is a trained mind. That is all training is.
You're here. Focus. That's all I ask.
Good. The gap is closed. Don't open it again.
I won't mention yesterday. You'll remember it anyway.
Returning is a skill. You have it. Need it less.
Hmph. You came back without being dragged. Noted.
Discipline lost, discipline regained. Now hold it.
Your focus wandered off. It found its way home. Good.
streak_milestone: {streak} days unbroken. You're becoming difficult to distract.
{streak} days. The weight is the same. You are not.
Hmph. {streak}. Don't let it make you careless.
{streak} days of quiet work. Few manage ten.
{streak}. I expected less of you. I was wrong.
A {streak}-day streak. Don't look at me. Keep going.
{streak} days. The mind sharpens with use.
{streak}. You're quieter now. That is strength.
{streak} days of focus. Don't speak of it. Continue.
{streak} in a row. You're no longer fighting yourself.
{streak} days. Don't admire the number. Admire nothing. Work.
boss_defeated: You stayed patient against {boss}. That won it.
Hmph. {boss} underestimated you. I no longer do.
Done. Don't celebrate long. There's always another.
You saw where {boss} was weak and kept at it. Good eyes.
{boss} fell to discipline, not luck. Remember which.
A long fight, well held. I have nothing to correct.
Good. Now rest your mind. It did most of the fighting.
{boss} lost to your patience. Most do.
Hmph. {boss} is defeated. Your focus never broke.
You were calm against {boss}. Calm wins wars.
{boss} is beaten. Now meditate. Victory clouds the mind.
Well done. {boss} never understood what consistency can do.
A clean finish against {boss}. I watched all of it.
Hmph. I expected {boss} to last longer. You've grown.
idle: One task. All of your attention. Nothing else exists.
The noise in your head is not an order. Ignore it.
Don't wait to feel ready. Ready comes after you begin.
Your enemy today is the urge to check something else.
Clear the mind. Then fill it with one thing.
Focus is a muscle. Train it.
A quiet hour is worth more than a busy day.
Your attention is your strength. Don't spend it cheaply.
Everything else can wait. It always has.

evening: The day isn't finished. Neither are you.
Evening. You have tasks left. Focus.
Before you rest, complete what you began.
The night is quiet. Use it.
Hmph. Still something left. Do it now.
Don't let the day end on a loose thread.
game: Sit. Close your eyes if you want. Follow the light.
Thoughts will come. Let them pass. Return to the breath.
Slower. You're not in a race.
Good. The mind is a muscle too.
Don't judge the breath. Just notice it.
Stillness is a technique. You're learning it.
Your shoulders are up. Drop them.
Nothing else needs you right now.
game_done: Done. You're calmer. Don't waste it.
Carry that quiet into the rest of the day.
Good. Now go and do one thing well.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Piccolo sits beneath a waterfall. He does not open his eyes.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Sit.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Until you stop asking.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Put these on. Cape and all.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: They weigh a ton. How do you think in these?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: That's the point. Learn to focus while something drags at you.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Something always will.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: How do I stop getting distracted?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You don't.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You get distracted. You notice. You return. A thousand times a day.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: The returning is the exercise. Stop treating it as failure.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Piccolo raises two fingers to his forehead and holds them there. Minutes pass.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Nothing's happening.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Everything is happening. I'm gathering it to one point.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Scattered effort scratches. Gathered effort pierces.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: The next time you fight, I'll stand with you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A storm breaks over the wasteland. Piccolo does not move.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Shouldn't we take shelter?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Can you hold your mind still out here?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: ...Yes.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Then an hour of your work is worth more than an hour of anyone else's. Stay.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: I trained a child once. Small. Cried constantly.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What happened to him?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: He stopped crying. Then he became stronger than me.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: I was harder on him than he deserved. I won't apologise. But I remember.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You sit together for an hour. Neither of you speaks.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You didn't fidget. First time.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I've seen you lose an arm and grow it back. Does it hurt?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: It takes energy and it takes focus. But what's lost comes back, if you don't panic.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Your bad days work the same way. You recover faster now. I've been watching.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Stand up.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Is the session over?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: The lessons are. You have a quiet mind. I can't improve on it.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You did well. I won't say it twice.
